products.title: Magids Abstract Armlocks by Magid Hage
products.body:
Get ready to see armlocks in a whole new light. In Magid’s Abstract Armlocks, world-class black belt and competition standout Magid Hage takes you deep into the world of unconventional, creative, and downright sneaky armlock attacks.

  • This isn’t your typical armbar series. Magid breaks down high-percentage submissions from unorthodox positions and transitions that your opponents will never see coming.
  • Whether you're attacking from guard, top position, scrambles, or even from “bad” spots — you’ll learn how to hunt arms from anywhere.
  • With laser-sharp detail, Magid shares setups, traps, and sequences developed over years of high-level competition. You’ll gain insight into how to make armlocks a real threat in your game — not just from standard positions, but from everywhere.

What Will You Learn?

Get ready to see armlocks in a whole new light. In Magid’s Abstract Armlocks, world-class black belt and competition standout Magid Hage takes you deep into the world of unconventional, creative, and downright sneaky armlock attacks.

This isn’t your typical armbar series. Magid breaks down high-percentage submissions from unorthodox positions and transitions that your opponents will never see coming. Whether you're attacking from guard, top position, scrambles, or even from “bad” spots — you’ll learn how to hunt arms from anywhere.

With laser-sharp detail, Magid shares setups, traps, and sequences developed over years of high-level competition. You’ll gain insight into how to make armlocks a real threat in your game — not just from standard positions, but from everywhere.

🔥 What You'll Learn:

  • 💥 Armlocks from Everywhere – Learn how to isolate and attack arms from closed guard, open guard, mount, side control, turtle, and transitional positions.

  • 🎯 Unorthodox Setups That Catch Everyone – Sneaky angles, unexpected grips, and creative entries that break the typical defensive reactions.

  • 🧠 Abstract Concepts, Concrete Results – Understand the principles behind effective armlocks, so you can adapt and apply them in any situation.

  • 🔄 Chains & Sequences – Go beyond one-off submissions with flowing chains and backup plans built into every attack.

  • 🕵️♂️ Hidden Details from a Master Technician – Magid’s attention to grip placement, weight distribution, and timing will level up your submission success rate.

  • 🏆 Proven in Competition – These aren’t just theoretical moves — they’re tested and battle-proven at the highest levels of the sport.

📦 Perfect For:

  • Intermediate to advanced grapplers looking to sharpen or diversify their armlock game

  • BJJ practitioners who love tricky, clever submissions that throw off standard defense

  • Anyone who wants a more dangerous guard or a more opportunistic top game

If you think you’ve seen all there is to see with armlocks — think again.
Let Magid Hage completely rewrite your approach to one of jiu-jitsu’s most iconic submissions.

👉 Unlock the abstract. Attack the arms. Surprise everyone.

products.title: The Best of Both Worlds by Magid Hage
products.body:
Learn World Class Strategies And Concepts For Underhooks & Overhooks From A Wide Range Of Positions!
  • Magid Hage is a world-class black belt competitor and instructor!
  • Learn pummeling drills you’ve never seen before that will help you gain an all-new perspective on obtaining both underhooks and overhooks.
  • Explore a variety of standing techniques like footsweeps, trips, lower body takedowns, and more while using the underhook.
  • Round out your standing game with a range of overhook based techniques as well.
  • Develop go-to techniques and strategies for both top and bottom scenarios.
  • Upgrade classic passes like the knee cut with brutal controlling details that maximize the use of powerful underhooks.
  • Unlock the power of the overhook from bottom positions with Magid’s sneaky triangles and the unique ghost escape darce choke!
